author: claude
summary: Final independent review of the voice-variant version-history feature. Confirmed the prior review's A/B fix holds (static routes containment-sound, version_id always membership-checked against versions.json before any path construction, HTTP-level tests assert real serving). Found and fixed one remaining defect in the A/B panel's poll cancellation: clearTimeout only cancels scheduled ticks, not a tick already awaiting the queue fetch, so a stale in-flight tick from a prior run could write the OLD job's render URL over the new run's pending state (stale-audio-served class) or re-arm a timer after unmount cleanup. Also surfaced failed/cancelled/timeout poll terminations as visible errors (previously silent dead button) and raised the poll timeout 30s -> 120s to accommodate cold-engine renders.

files.change: Added pollRunIdRef generation counter: bumped on each new comparison run and on unmount; poll ticks re-check it at tick start and after every await and bail on mismatch, so an in-flight stale tick can never setResult/setPollingSide against a newer run. Poll timeout raised to 120s; failed/cancelled/timeout now set a visible error message instead of terminating silently.

Added a regression test: a poll tick left in-flight (hung getProcessingQueue promise) across a re-run resolves reporting the old job done, and must not surface the old job's render URL nor clear the new run's rendering state. R1 revert-checked (fails with the runId guards removed).
